title: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live
abstract: arXiv:2611.19118v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A voice agent that negotiates by phone must answer quickly, understand spoken amounts and cope with a caller who talks over it. We compared three architectures for such an agent, negotiating freight rates in Spanish: two cascades (speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis) orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and GPT-Live, an OpenAI speech model that listens and speaks without separate stages. A program played the carrier with the same 47 recordings of one speaker for all agents, without the telephone network, in 77 calls per architecture over five negotiation scenarios, and measured latency on the listener's side with a validated instrument. Median latency to the content response was 2,616.0 ms (Pipecat), 3,090.0 ms (LiveKit) and 2,444.8 ms (GPT-Live); the confidence interval of GPT-Live's 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat includes zero. translated_title: 西班牙语电话谈判语音代理中的延迟、语音识别与话轮转换：Pipecat、LiveKit 与 GPT-Live 的外部测量比较
translated_abstract: 通过电话进行谈判的语音代理必须快速应答、理解口头报出的金额，并应对通话者的抢话打断。我们比较了此类代理的三种架构，用于以西班牙语谈判运费：由 Pipecat 和 LiveKit Agents 编排的两个级联系统（语音识别、语言模型和语音合成），以及 GPT-Live——一个无需独立处理阶段即可边听边说的 OpenAI 语音模型。实验由一个程序扮演承运方，对所有代理使用同一位说话者的 47 段相同录音，在不经过电话网络的条件下，针对五种谈判场景对每种架构各进行 77 通电话，并使用经过验证的仪器在听者一侧测量延迟。内容响应的中位延迟为：Pipecat 2,616.0 毫秒、LiveKit 3,090.0 毫秒、GPT-Live 2,444.8 毫秒；GPT-Live 相对 Pipecat 的 171.2 毫秒优势的置信区间包含零。根据其自身的时间戳，GPT-Live 在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本研究在西班牙语运费电话谈判任务中，用统一的外部测量方法比较 Pipecat、LiveKit 和 GPT-Live 三种语音代理架构，发现 GPT-Live 的内容响应中位延迟最低（2,444.8 毫秒），但其相对 Pipecat 的 171.2 毫秒优势在统计上并不显著。
en_tdlr: Using identical external measurements in Spanish freight-rate phone negotiations, this study compares Pipecat, LiveKit, and GPT-Live voice agents and finds that GPT-Live achieves the lowest median content-response latency (2,444.8 ms), though its 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat is not statistically significant.
